message: No detected input validation: The code reads the CSV directly with pd.read_csv() and logs the shape, but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, column existence checks, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path with no remote source involved, and no checksum, signature, or integrity verification of any kind is performed.

No detected label flipping detection: There is no check on label distributions, validation of label values against an expected set, or use of any label-noise detection tool anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code builds models from scratch using scikit-learn and statsmodels; no pretrained weights or serialized models are loaded, and no hash/signature verification is performed anywhere in the pipeline.

No detected label distribution validation: The code performs outlier removal and train/test splitting but never checks or validates the distribution of the target label (concrete_compressive_strength) before training begins.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation analysis, trigger detection, or any other backdoor defense mechanism in the training code; it simply fits standard sklearn/statsmodels regression models.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or used anywhere in the pipeline code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries or attack methods (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/test splitting is performed, there is no hashing or signing of evaluation data, no holdout set isolated from all training decisions, and no use of multiple independent metrics or verification mechanisms to protect against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code reads a CSV directly and applies only outlier removal and feature scaling; there are no shape/range checks, schema validation, or rejection of malformed inputs on the inference path.
No detected output bounds checks: Predictions are generated and stored/evaluated without any NaN guards, range checks, or sanity bounds on the model outputs.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a tabular regression pipeline (concrete compressive strength), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
